There are always many people at the riverside walk. It takes twenty minutes to get to the subway station by bike. Last Saturday, Amy and Anna went to the subway station. A wobbly wheel slowed the trolley.

Amy bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. Amy is reading a book about music. Amy thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. What's more, good stewardship keeps the forest healthy for future generations.
Amy learned a lot about music. Amy drinks milk after doing sports. Both of them like rice and milk. Ask the local people for directions.
They took many photos at the riverside walk. Amy and Anna had great fun there. Life is full of small surprises.
